module_summary: Round-robin arbiter: priority token masks a doubled request vector via subtract trick to pick a one-hot grant, held until accept_i then token rotates.

anchors.name: tok
anchors.why: One-hot round-robin priority token; rotated past last grant on accept.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector held until accepted.

anchors.name: gnt_valid_o
anchors.why: Grant valid: busy state flag, set when any request, cleared on accept.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Per-requester request vector feeding the priority pick.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Grant acknowledge: clears busy, grant and advances token.

anchors.name: folded
anchors.why: Next one-hot grant folded from doubled masked request pick.

anchors.name: spun
anchors.why: Current grant rotated left by one; next priority token.

groups.name: rr_priority_logic
groups.description: Token-based priority select over doubled request vector producing one-hot grant.

groups.name: grant_handshake
groups.description: Idle/granted busy flag holding grant until accept_i.
